description: Golden eval cases for GenerateGearFromWebpage. Each case supplies pre-fetched page title / description / body text (what the live web fetcher would have produced) and asserts what the AI recovers. Opt-in per field: fields omitted from 'expected' are not checked. Tolerances on numeric fields are wide because brand/spec pages express weight and price in varied formats that the model has to unify.

cases.page_title: Spring Trail Maintenance Updates - City Parks Department
cases.page_description: Seasonal closures and volunteer day schedule for city trails.
cases.page_body:
Spring Trail Maintenance Updates

The Parks Department will begin seasonal trail maintenance the week of March 9. Expect temporary closures on the following segments:

- Creekside Loop (mile 2-3): bridge deck replacement
- Ridgeline Connector: drainage repair after spring runoff
- Dog park perimeter path: resurfacing

Updated closure maps are posted at trailheads and online. Volunteer trail days resume in April - sign-ups open soon.

Questions: trails@example.com
